## Preliminary Results

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column}

- Existing work showed statistical significance of processed time-series data
    - Power Spectral Densities
    - Heart/Respiratory Rate
    - Heart Rate Variability


:::{.fragment  data-fragment-index="1"}
- By letting a deep learning model analyze the raw data, it can infer these processed features naturally and draw significance
:::

:::{.fragment  data-fragment-index="2"}
- A flaw in previous DAQ version caused significant data loss for preliminary model
:::

:::{.fragment  data-fragment-index="3"}
- New EEG data is currently being collected. A cleaning pipeline using independent component analysis is currently under construction
:::
